snippet.title: Everfront - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Everfront - a real-time roguelike where your territory is the army.
                                                                      
No units to micromanage. No bases to build. You command an expanding territory that grows, fights, and yields in real time. Where you commit, you overwhelm. Where you don't, you yield.          
                                                                                                                                                                                            Master six doctrines - Focus, Blitz, Entrenchment, Avoidance, Terrain, Naval - each unlocking different upgrade paths and playstyles. Every run is procedurally generated.

🎯 Wishlist on Steam: https://s.team/a/4681770?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=bio&utm_campaign=launch
🌐 Website: https://everfrontgame.com
💬 Discord: https://discord.gg/vaj7pvAF9
🐦 X: https://x.com/everfrontgame
☁️  Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/everfrontgame.bsky.social
📰 Reddit: https://www.reddit.com/r/Everfront/

Made by Wilhelm Tranheden, a solo developer in Gothenburg, Sweden. Built in Godot 4.5.

Coming November 2026 · PC, Mac, Linux

Music: "Heroic" by The_Mountain                                                                                                                                                        via Pixabay (https://pixabay.com/music/epic-classical-heroic-heroic-music-508023/)
